subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the meeting-browser permission callback remain backward-compatible for external Plugin SDK adapters while Teams receives the meeting URL through an additive contract?
rationale: The branch changes an SDK-facing callback from a previous caller shape to a required new input; deciding whether to preserve, deprecate, or intentionally break that public contract needs explicit owner intent.

options.title: Add an additive compatibility path
options.body: Keep the existing permission callback callable without meetingUrl and provide the URL as an optional/additive input so existing adapters continue to compile while Teams can safely restrict its grants.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK revision
options.body: Intentionally require meetingUrl only with explicit maintainer approval, documented upgrade guidance, and compatibility tests for all supported adapters.

recommendation.title: Add an additive compatibility path
recommendation.body: Keep the existing permission callback callable without meetingUrl and provide the URL as an optional/additive input so existing adapters continue to compile while Teams can safely restrict its grants.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Teams adapter and authored the shared contract change in this follow-up.
